body:
Could you use a little joy in your life? Who couldn't, right? That's why Selenite is always on the top of our list of favorite crystals. We try not to pick favorites, but it's hard not to favor such a purely positive crystal. Selenite stones have a soft but impactful energy. The selenite meaning is all about uplifting everything around it. The radiant vibrations of a selenite stone will recharge your spirit, your environment and even the crystals that surround it. This selenite stone is conveniently sized to place in your purse or pocket so you can bring the light energy of this crystal wherever you go.

The pure, high vibrational energy of selenite is like liquid light. It has the ability to cleanse, purify and align you with your highest potential, shifting your aura and vibration to attune you with a higher energy. It does so by clearing energy blockages and aligning the chakras. After selenite works its magic, you will feel radiant light energy flowing fluidly throughout the body. This makes selenite a powerful tool for removing negativity from your energy field. It is also used in holistic medicine treatments for physical healing.

The selenite stone meaning especially connects to the third eye, crown, transpersonal and Etheric chakras. By opening and activating these energy centers, selenite stones help you reach higher planes and connect to your highest sense of self. Because of its link to these chakras and its ability to connect you to your highest level of consciousness, selenite is an ideal stone for connecting with spirit guides or guardian angels. Working with this stone leaves you more open and accepting of symbolic messaging.

Another of the selenite properties is that it magnifies and amplifies the energy of anything near it, making it a perfect stone to use in combination with any other stones you are working with.

When you're depleted and need to recharge, your spirit will reach for selenite stones. The pure white light of a selenite stone will fill you with high vibrational energy. Feel renewed and refreshed by the selenite properties.
